title: Account Settings, Security, & Subscriptions Login troubleshooting, managing your personal information and payment methods, and account security best practices.

articles.title: I need help getting logged in.

content.text: If you have trouble logging into your Sezzle account, you’ve come to the right place! See the instructions and resources below to help you navigate the various factors needed to log in.
I forgot my PIN.
To log in to your Sezzle account, you will need your phone number and the 4-digit PIN you selected when you created your account. If you need to reset your PIN, follow the steps here .
I never set-up a PIN and don't have access to my phone/email.

If you never set up a PIN when logging into Sezzle and you no longer have access to your phone number or email address that was used, please reach out to our customer support. See How do I contact Sezzle Shopper Support?

When you log in to your Sezzle account, you may be asked to verify a one-time passcode (OTP) sent to your mobile device after entering your phone number and PIN. Learn more about what to do if you are not receiving OTPs here .
Do not share one-time passcodes (OTPs) with anyone. If someone asks for this code, it’s a scam.
I'm not getting the verification email.

If you attempt to reset your PIN, change your phone number, or verify your email address, an email will be sent to the email address listed on your Sezzle account for verification. Learn more about what to do if you are not receiving this email here .
I changed my phone number.
Click here to learn how to get logged in after changing your phone number.
How do I use my fingerprint or face ID to sign in?
You can now use your fingerprint or face ID to sign in to your Sezzle account! Learn more about how to enable and utilize this functionality here .

articles.title: How do I reset my PIN?

content.text: To log in to your Sezzle account, you will need your phone number and the 4-digit PIN you selected when you created your account. If you need to reset your PIN, you can follow the steps below:
Visit sezzle.com/pin or click here.
Enter your phone number and select “Continue.”
Input the code we text you.
Check your email and follow the link to the PIN reset screen.
Please note if you are trying to reset your PIN on a mobile device, make sure you are logged out of your Sezzle account both in the browser and in your Sezzle app before completing the steps above.
Do not share one-time passcodes (OTPs) with anyone. If someone asks for this code, it’s a scam.

articles.title: How do I verify my email address?

content.text: When you create a Sezzle account, we verify your email address for security and fraud prevention. If you experience issues during the verification process, you can take a few troubleshooting steps to resolve the issue.
I did not receive the email to verify my email address.
Ensure your email address was entered correctly without any typos. If you find an error in your email address, you can change it in your dashboard. Follow the instructions here to do so.
Check your spam and trash folders.
Make sure you do not have another Sezzle account. If you have a duplicate Sezzle account, follow the instructions here to close it.
Wait about 5-10 minutes to receive the verification email.
I received the email to verify my email address, but the code is not working.
If multiple verification emails were sent, please enter the code from the most recent email.
Make sure you enter the code exactly as it appears in your email.
How do I verify my email address if I already have a Sezzle account?
Email verification is not required for existing Sezzle accounts, but we recommend verifying your email address to ensure your account's security. You can do this by following the steps below:
Log into your Sezzle dashboard.
Navigate to your initial in the upper left corner.
Click on "Personal Information."
Under "Email," there will be an option to resend the email verification code.
Check your email inbox for the verification email.

articles.title: What do I do if I do not receive the one-time passcode text messages?

content.text: When you log in to your Sezzle account, as an added security measure, you may be asked to verify a one-time passcode (OTP) sent to your mobile device after entering your phone number and PIN. If you are being prompted to enter an OTP and aren’t receiving the text messages, there are a couple of troubleshooting steps you can take:
Make sure your phone is actively connected to a cellular network. (A quick test call to a familiar number often confirms that the connection is active and pulls in any pending text messages.)
Confirm that your carrier or messaging app is not blocking our texts. For example, if you have messages from unknown senders disabled, Sezzle texts may not come through.
Do you have a new phone number and need to receive text messages on your new number?
You'll need to change your phone number before logging in to your account. Learn more about how to change your phone number here .

articles.title: What do I do if I don't receive a verification email?

content.text: If you attempt to reset your PIN, change your phone number, or verify your email address, an email will be sent to the email address listed on your Sezzle account for verification. If you are not receiving this email, please use the troubleshooting steps below:

Make sure you are checking the correct email inbox. Sometimes, having two similar email addresses (example@gmail.com and example@icloud.com) can cause confusion. Please check all your known email inboxes for any messages from Sezzle.

Check spam and junk folders. While we do our best not to spam your inbox, email providers sometimes automatically flag emails from Sezzle as spam. If your inbox doesn't have any messages from Sezzle, please check your spam and junk folders, and be sure to add our email address to your contacts to ensure other emails from us go straight to your inbox.
No longer have access to the email on your Sezzle account?

If you no longer have access to the email address associated with your Sezzle account, update the email address listed in your dashboard to your new email. You can do this in your dashboard in the "Personal Information" section.

articles.title: How do I use my fingerprint or face ID to sign in to my Sezzle account?

content.text: You can now use your fingerprint or face ID to sign into your Sezzle app! Follow these steps to enable biometric sign-in and use your fingerprint to access your Sezzle dashboard.
Log into your Sezzle dashboard .
Navigate to “Account" by selecting your initial in the upper left-hand corner of the page.
Click on “Security.”
Toggle the switch next to “Use fingerprint to sign in,” and confirm your fingerprint.
*Please note your device may be enabled to accept a Face ID as a form of biometric identification, so this step will be tailored to the specifics of your device.
I'm having trouble logging in with my fingerprint.

Firstly, ensure you use version 3.0.9 of the Sezzle app or higher. If you still can’t use your biometric sign-in, whether with your fingerprint or Face ID, please use your phone number and PIN to log into your Sezzle dashboard instead. If you continue to experience issues, we recommend checking the configuration of your biometric ID in your device’s settings menu.

articles.title: How do I update my account information?

content.text: To make account changes more streamlined, you can access nearly every setting by logging into your account and going to your account information page.
Personal Information

The "Personal Information" page allows you to change your email address, phone number, and billing address. Remember: changing your address in Sezzle doesn't impact what address orders are shipped to. If you need to change your shipping address for a specific order, please contact the merchant directly as soon as possible.
Note that we cannot use P.O. boxes for billing or residential addresses.

Sezzle is currently only available in the U.S., its territories, and Canada. The country of residence tied to your Sezzle account cannot be updated once it’s created. If you’ve moved or need to use Sezzle in a different country, we recommend closing your current account and creating a new one for your new location. To close your account, please see the instructions here .
Phone Number
You can learn more about changing your phone number here .
Do not share one-time passcodes (OTPs) with anyone. If someone asks for this code, it’s a scam.
Name Change
If you need to update the name on your account, please contact us directly here. Please be ready to provide documentation of your name change for verification purposes.
Payment Methods
To see instructions to change the payment method on your account or what payment methods we accept, click here .
Preferred Language

Sezzle is available in French for all Canadian users. You can adjust your preferred language from your Sezzle dashboard or the Sezzle app. Go to the “Account” tab, click “Preferred Language,” then select your choice. To change it back from French, "Langue préférée." French is only available in Canada.
Notification Settings
The toggle to opt in or out of marketing promotions can be found in "Notifications ."
Reschedule a Payment
See instructions to reschedule a payment here .

articles.title: Why is Sezzle asking for my SSN and how do I verify it?

content.text: Sezzle has entered into a partnership with WebBank to expand the range of products available to our customers. As part of this partnership, we verify customers' identities by requesting SSNs when opening new accounts or approving new orders. This verification step has no impact on your credit score.

The security of your personal information is a priority for Sezzle. Your SSN will only be used for identity verification purposes. Your personal information will be encrypted and provided only to Sezzle banking partners through a secure connection.
You can verify your SSN the next time you create a purchase request, at the next Sezzle checkout, or by selecting your initial in the upper left-hand corner of the Sezzle app or your dashboard.
I'm having trouble verifying my SSN.

Please keep in mind that you should never share your Social Security number with anyone over the phone or through email. A Sezzle Shopper Support agent will never ask for it, either. For Sezzle’s verification purposes, you only need to enter it in the secure verification tool when prompted by Sezzle.

articles.title: How do I change my phone number?

content.text: Changing Your Phone Number in the Dashboard

Log in here and navigate the "Account" tab by selecting your initial in the upper left-hand corner of the page. (If you do so from the Sezzle app, you will be redirected to a web browser to change your phone number.)
Then select "Personal Information" and the "edit" button under the phone number listed.
Provide your new number and confirm your identity with a one-time password sent to the new phone number.
Do not share one-time passcodes (OTPs) with anyone. If someone asks for this code, it’s a scam.

If you do not have access to your account, we require more information to keep your account safe. You’ll need to remember your PIN and have access to the email associated with your account. If you do not have either of those items, please see the resources below before attempting to change your number:
Help Article: I forgot my PIN. How do I reset it so I can log in?
Help Article: I was supposed to receive a verification email, but it's not appearing in my inbox.
Changing Your Phone Number Without Logging In
Click here to get started.
Enter your old phone number.
Enter the 6-digit code sent to the email on file. (Do not share one-time passcodes (OTPs) with anyone. If someone asks for this code, it’s a scam.)
Enter your full Social Security number on file and click “Continue.”
Connect to the Plaid Identity Verification Portal by clicking “Continue.”
Scan the QR code shown with your phone’s camera or click on the option to send a link to your phone (both options will redirect you to the Plaid Identity Verification page)
Select the type of ID you would like to use for verification (Driver’s license, ID card, Passport, Residency Permit Card, or Temporary Visa)
Capture a photo of the required identification type
Capture a photo of yourself (selfie) for additional identification
Click “Finish” once the Plaid ID Verification process has been completed
Enter your new phone number and click “Continue” to complete the phone change process

Why do we ask for your SSN? The security of your personal information is a priority for Sezzle. Our banking partners require us to collect and verify this information. This verification step has no impact on your credit score.
Your SSN will only be used for identity verification purposes. Your personal information will be encrypted and provided only to Sezzle banking partners through a secure connection.
For SSN troubleshooting tips, I'm having trouble verifying my SSN.

Note : If you opened a new Sezzle account with your new phone number, you must close that before you can update your original account. Maintaining one Sezzle account is crucial because we want to ensure you can preserve any order history, and you lose that when you open a new account. To close it, log in and select your initial in the upper left-hand corner of the page, "Personal Information," and finally, "Close Account.”

articles.title: How do I update my notification settings?

content.text: You can update your notification settings from the Sezzle app or your device.
To adjust your account's notifications settings for marketing emails, SMS, and push notifications, log in to the Sezzle app, go to “Account,” click “Notifications,” and turn the toggle on or off.
To adjust these settings from your device:
Opting in and out of SMS - Reply STOP to any Sezzle text to stop and START to resume
Opting in and out of push notifications Change notification settings on iPhone Control notifications on Android
To unsubscribe from marketing emails, click “Unsubscribe,” located at the bottom of marketing emails.

Note that  some transactional emails, such as order confirmations and payment reminder emails, are not subject to opt out. You will continue to receive transactional emails even if you opt out of marketing communications.

articles.title: I don't remember signing up for Sezzle Premium or Anywhere.

content.text: Anywhere is available for U.S. Shoppers only. If enrolled, Sezzle Premium and Anywhere are accessible in the Sezzle app. Availability and pricing plans may vary by individual.
I f you are eligible, you may join or upgrade to a Sezzle Premium or Anywhere membership at some checkouts with Sezzle.
If you see a charge for a subscription and do not recall purchasing it:
Did you upgrade or join Premium or Anywhere at checkout?
See this resource for what to do when you have an unrecognized order on your account

articles.title: How do I cancel my Anywhere or Sezzle Premium subscription?

content.text: To cancel your subscription:
Log in to your Sezzle mobile app.
Go to the “Accounts” tab by selecting your initial in the upper left-hand corner of the screen.
Click on the "Subscriptions" section where your current Premium or Anywhere membership is displayed. This will bring you to the Sezzle Premium or Anywhere Subscription Benefits page.
Click on the settings icon in the upper right-hand corner of the screen and then click "Manage subscription."
Click on the "Cancel Subscription" button at the bottom of the screen. Your subscription will be canceled at the end of the current billing cycle, and you will not be charged any additional fees.
If you are logged in to your Dashboard on the Sezzle website:
Click the “Account” button in the upper-right corner of the screen.
Click on the "Subscriptions" section where your current Premium or Anywhere membership is displayed.
Click on the "Cancel Subscription" button. Your subscription will be canceled at the end of the current billing cycle, and you will not be charged any additional fees.

We recommend making any changes to your subscription payment plan at least 24 hours before the billing date. If a change is made to your account within 24 hours of the payment being processed, we cannot guarantee that the change will go through before your next payment.

articles.title: How do I add a new payment method?

content.text: Note: Unfortunately, if your installment has already been paid or started processing, the payment method cannot be changed.
See the instructions below for how to add each type of payment method accepted by Sezzle:
Debit or Credit Card Bank Account Prepaid Card
Debit or Credit Card
From the Sezzle app or your Sezzle dashboard, go to “Account,” then navigate to  “ Payment Methods ”
Click "+ Add Card" and input your card details.
Once added, you can choose to have the card set as the default for down payments.

When adding a card, please verify that the card number, expiration, and CVV (three-digit code on the back for most cards) are all correct. If your card is set to expire within the next 60 days, our system will not allow this card to be added. If this is the case, please attempt to add a different payment method. Also, ensure the billing address matches what the financial institution has for this card.

If you add a debit or credit card to your account and it appears in the "Prepaid card" section, your financial institution has designated the card as a prepaid card. If you have questions about why a card is labeled as a prepaid card, please contact your card issuer directly (typically by calling the phone number on the back of the card) to learn more about the card.
Please note: Early payments cannot be made directly using a debit or credit card on orders placed after August 28th, 2025. However, you can pay early by either:
Using your Sezzle Balance (which can be funded with a debit card or bank account)
Paying directly with your linked bank account
Bank Account
From the Sezzle app or your Sezzle dashboard, go to “Account,” then navigate to “ Payment Methods ”
Select "+ Add Bank/Checking Account."

To make it easier for you to add a bank account, we have two linking methods: Near the bottom of the page, see "Log in via Plaid." This allows you to use your online banking username and password to log into your bank account and select the account you want to link. If your bank isn't on the list of options to instantly link, or if you run into issues logging into your bank account, you can also add your bank account manually. Select "Link bank account" and enter your account and routing numbers. Within 3-5 business days, we'll deposit two micro-deposits (less than $1.00 each) and immediately withdraw one (which will be the sum of the two deposits, less than $2.00 total). Afterward, you must return to the "Payment Methods" page to verify the withdrawn amounts. Once your account is verified, it’s ready for use! Please ensure the account being added has sufficient funds at the time of the micro-deposits to avoid any potential NSF fees that the subsequent withdrawal of those deposits could incur. Note that Sezzle is not responsible for and cannot assist you with any inquiries concerning fees assessed by your bank.

Bank accounts cannot be used as payment methods for down payments but can be used for other scheduled installments. Once you've added your bank account, you can designate it as the default payment method for scheduled installments on the Payment Methods screen.
Prepaid Card
From the Sezzle app or your Sezzle dashboard, go to “Account,” then  Navigate to “ Payment Methods .”
Click on "+ Add Prepaid Card" and input your card details.
Once added, it will automatically appear in that page's "Prepaid card" section.

Since prepaid cards can't be used to place orders or for scheduled installments, you won't have the option to set them as your default payment method. However, you can use them to pay off existing installments. To learn about how to pay off installments, click here .
Looking for more information about using your prepaid card with Sezzle? Click here for more information.

articles.title: How do I set a payment method as the default?

content.text: In order to use Sezzle, you must set both a default down payment method and a default scheduled payment method. These payment methods will automatically be charged when making a purchase or when a payment is due.
We require that you set two default payment methods on your account:
Down payments: This payment method will be used for the payment due when you place an order. Only debit or credit cards can be used for the down payment of any order.

Scheduled payments: This payment method will be used for all subsequent payments. You can set a bank account as the default for scheduled payments. However, not having a bank account as default for scheduled payments may incur a late saver fee. Learn more about the late saver fee and how to avoid it here.
Prepaid cards cannot be set as a default payment method - learn more about how prepaid cards can be used here.
How do I set or change default payment methods?
Log into the Sezzle app or your Sezzle dashboard.
Navigate to the "Account" tab.
Click on "Payment Methods."
Select "+ Add card" if you haven't yet added one to your Sezzle account.
Once you've typed in your card details, check the box below that says, "Make default payment method for down payments."

At this point, you will need to add a bank account as the default payment method for scheduled payments. Just enter the details for your bank and check the box that says "Make default payment method for scheduled payments."
I changed my default payment method, but my old one was still charged.

Adding a payment method does not automatically set that payment method to be used on outstanding orders. If you’d like all unpaid payments to be charged to your new payment method, you must set it as the default after you add it to your account. To update your default payment method, simply go to Payment Methods , select the payment method you'd like to use, then select "Set as default".
Please make all changes to the default payment method at least 48 hours before the payment is due. Changes made within 48 hours of the payment due date may not take effect.

articles.title: My payment method isn't supported.

content.text: If you're having trouble with your payment method, it's likely it is unsupported, and you will need to try adding a different one. See How do I add a new payment method?

Please also note that prepaid or benefits cards can be used to correct outstanding payments, but cannot be used to place new orders or complete early payments. Click here to learn more about how prepaid cards can be used with Sezzle.

My bank is not accepted as a default payment method for first installments. Bank accounts cannot be used as default payment methods for first installments on new orders. You may set your bank account as the default payment method for scheduled installments. However, you must have a debit or credit card on file set as the first installment payment method on your account.

My card is not accepted as a default payment method for scheduled installments. Debit/credit cards cannot be used as default payment methods for scheduled installments on new orders. However, you can choose a bank account on file as the payment method for scheduled payments on your account.

You can change your default payment methods for the first and following scheduled installments by navigating to your Sezzle dashboard, selecting your initial in the upper left-hand corner of the page, and then "Payment Methods."

articles.title: Can I pay off an order by check or other non-electronic method?

content.text: We offer alternative payment options.
Paying by Check Paying with Sezzle Balance
Paying by Check
Requirements:

Must be written to Sezzle from the account holder. Checks from escrow, mortgage, or credit consolidation companies may be accepted as long as the check follows all other criteria and clearly specifies to whom the funds should be applied. Checks from individuals who are not the account holder will not be accepted. If someone you know wants to assist you in paying Sezzle, you may wish to have them give you the money so you can pay us directly.

Must be received by Sezzle by 6 pm CT on the payment due date. Remember that Sezzle has no control over when the postal mail reaches our office, so please consider this when mailing payments. Business days are Monday through Friday, excluding Saturday, Sunday, and Federal holidays. Processing Timeline for Check Payments. Once Sezzle receives your check, it will be applied to your account the same day.

Must be for the exact amount of the payment(s) owed to Sezzle. Partial payments cannot be accepted, nor can Sezzle accept checks that are not for the exact amount due (higher or lower). We will destroy any checks we receive that we cannot process due to a payment amount mismatch.
For proper crediting, your check must be made payable to Sezzle and must include the following information in the memo line:
The phone number associated with your Sezzle account
Sezzle Order # (this can be found on the Order Details page within the Customer Dashboard)
Checks must be mailed to the following address:
Sezzle Inc. 700 Nicollet Mall Suite 640 Minneapolis, MN 55402
If the check is not received on time, ​the payment will be attempted on a payment method on file. Any failed and late payments are subject to fees where applicable.
Paying with Sezzle Balance

You can pay for outstanding installments through Sezzle Balance, a digital account within the Sezzle platform that functions like a gift card. Sezzle Balance can be loaded with a debit card, or ACH, allowing you to easily store, manage, and spend funds. It is available to U.S. residents (excluding territories) who are at least 18 years old. For more information, check out the FAQ article: What is Sezzle Balance? ​​

articles.title: I’m having trouble adding or updating a card.

content.text: Adding a New Card
Here are a few common reasons why a card may be rejected by our system:

The information was entered incorrectly. Please verify that the card number, expiration, and CVV (three-digit code on the back for most cards) are all correct. If your card is set to expire within the next 60 days, our system will not allow this card to be added. If this is the case, please attempt to add a different payment method.
The billing address does not match what the financial institution has.
The card itself is being declined.

Unfortunately, we do not have specific information as to why your card may be getting declined. If all information is correct and it is still not working, please contact your bank directly for additional information as to why your card is unable to be verified or attempt to add a different card or bank account.
Updating a Card on File
If you are having difficulties updating your card information on file. Please follow the steps below:

Upload a completely different payment method to your Sezzle account. Because you must have at least one debit/credit card on file, adding a new card first will allow you to remove the card with the incorrect information (step 2).
Remove the card on file that contains outdated information.
Add your card back to the account with the updated information. All the card details, including the billing address, must match what the financial institution has on file.
Additionally, orders cannot be placed using a prepaid card, so if you are replacing a prepaid card, please add a debit or credit card instead.

articles.title: What is a prepaid card and how can I use it?

content.text: What is a prepaid card?
Prepaid cards are payment cards issued by financial institutions not attached to a specific bank account. They have a prepaid amount of funds that can be used for purchases.

If you add a debit or credit card to your account and it appears in the "Prepaid card" section, your financial institution has designated the card as a prepaid card. If you have questions about why a card is labeled as a prepaid card, please contact your card issuer directly (typically by calling the phone number on the back of the card) to learn more about the card.
How can I use my prepaid card with Sezzle?
Prepaid cards can only be used to add funds to your Sezzle Balance. To learn more about Sezzle Balance, see What is Sezzle Balance?
Prepaid cards cannot be set as default payment methods or used to place new orders.

articles.title: How to recognize and report a scam.

content.text: Sezzle takes fraud and security very seriously. Review the resources below regarding security and learn how to shop responsibly and avoid scams while using Sezzle.
How do I lock my virtual card and report fraudulent activity?
What can I do to secure my account?
How does Sezzle protect my account?
How secure is Sezzle?
Gift Card Scams

Per the Federal Trade Commission, “No real business or government agency will ever tell you to buy a gift card to pay them.” Only scammers demand payment with a gift card like Google Play, Apple, Nordstrom, or Lowe’s. Gift cards can only be used at the store which they are for. If a scammer pretending to be Facebook support asks you to buy a Nordstrom gift card, that’s a scam.

The Federal Trade Commission also lists some methods scammers use to scam victims by pretending to be from the government, “tech support,” a friend or relative with an emergency, or your utility company.
Other Common signs of gift card scams
Urgency: scammers say you must pay them with a gift card urgently, or bad things will happen.
Scammers tell you which gift card you must buy or which brick-and-mortar store you can buy it from. They may stay on the phone or in contact with you throughout this process.
Scammers will ask you for the gift card details, such as the gift card number and PIN.
Scammers will tell you that the gift card is refundable. Gift cards are non-refundable.
How Can I Avoid Scams
STOP and ask yourself, “Why is this company asking me to buy a gift card from another company?”
DISCONNECT and contact the company or government agency that asks you to buy and share a gift card to validate that they contacted you.
DO NOT SHARE gift card details with people you do not know.
Watch out for Credit Card Scams
Use a Secure Internet Connection
Make sure the website URL starts with HTTPS and a padlock icon. Websites with a URL that starts with https indicate a secure connection.
Avoid Deals Too Good to be True

The old saying “if it is too good to be true, then it probably is” applies. Question if a merchant offers a product at too low of a price. Verify the price of the item at other merchants to decide if the price is unreasonably low.
Check If the Website or the Merchant is Legitimate

Take a few precautionary steps to check the validity of the merchant before sharing your card details. A simple search on Google or Bing for reviews of the merchant or whether anyone else reported scams with the merchant can go a long way.
Report fraud and scams

Contact the Federal Trade Commission (FTC), which handles complaints about deceptive or unfair business practices. To learn more about common gift card scams, visit FTC.gov/giftcards . To file a complaint, visit https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/#/ , call 1-877-FTC-HELP, or write to: Federal Trade Commission, CRC-240, Washington, D.C. 20580

If your complaint is against a company in a country other than the United States, or you want to find information on where to report in locations outside the United States, visit http://www.econsumer.gov .

If you believe you have been a victim of a scam or have been exposed to one while shopping at Sezzle, contact us to speak with a member of our Support team. You can also alert us if you receive a suspicious call, or encounter any other uses of the Sezzle name that you think may be fraudulent.

articles.title: How do I lock the virtual card and report fraudulent activity?

content.text: You can protect yourself against any potentially fraudulent activity on the Sezzle virtual card 1 by canceling/locking it to prevent usage and reporting fraudulent charges from your Sezzle app.
Single-use Card
How to Cancel a Single-Use Card
Log into your Sezzle dashboard or mobile app and navigate to the “Virtual Card” tab.
Select the card you would like to cancel and click “Cancel Card.”
Reporting Fraudulent Activity
Contact support to report any fraudulent or unrecognized activity and we would be happy to investigate.
Multi-use Card (Anywhere users)
How to Lock the Multi-Use Card
Log into your Sezzle dashboard or mobile app and navigate to the “Virtual Card” tab.
Click “Lock Card” and select “Lock Card” in the pop-up window to confirm.
Once the card has been locked, it cannot be used for any purchases.
When you feel the card is safe to use again, click the same toggle again, and the card will be unlocked. Once this has been selected, the Virtual Card will be available for use.
Reporting Fraudulent Activity On the Multi-Use Virtual Card
You can report this activity directly from the “Virtual Card” tab if you believe the Virtual Card has been used fraudulently.

From there, select “Report a Problem.” You will then be guided through questions to gather evidence regarding your claim. Once you answer all the questions, the information will be sent to our team for investigation, and the Virtual Card will be locked.
Until a resolution to the reported issue has been found, you cannot unlock the Virtual Card.
This means that if you report fraudulent activity, you will need to wait until our team has concluded its investigation before using the Virtual Card again.

*Sezzle Virtual Cards are issued by WebBank, Member FDIC, pursuant to a license from Visa U.S.A Inc . See User Agreement for details. Sezzle provides access to financing in the form of installment loans.
Sezzle is not a bank.

articles.title: What can I do to secure my account?

content.text: Fraudsters are busy, don't fall victim to hacking and fraud by taking a few simple common sense steps. Let’s take a look at some of the basics:
Choose Your PIN Wisely & Safeguard It

Select a PIN that is easy to remember but difficult to guess and unique to your account. Having “0000” or “1234” for a PIN or using the same PIN for all or most of your accounts compromises your PIN and is like handing over the keys to your kingdom.
Don't share your PIN, and don't write it down or store it where it is accessible by people other than you.
Do not share one-time passcodes (OTPs) with anyone. If someone asks for this code, it’s a scam.
Strengthen Your Password
A strong password includes a variety of upper and lower case letters, numbers, and special characters and some punctuation where allowed. Avoid using easy-to-guess passwords such as “Password”.
Consider using a password manager if you are not good at remembering passwords. Most web browsers offer this feature for free now.
Secure Your Email Address

Similar to securing your Sezzle account, it is essential to secure your email address too. Follow the guidelines above to select a strong password and use two-step authentication if it is available. Use an authentication app such as Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator if your email provider allows it.
How Can I Protect My Information?
Don't Fall Victim to Phishing
Phishing is when fraudsters and hackers pretend as if they are legitimate contacts and aim to get information from you to access your accounts.
Beware of Sketchy Communication

Don’t open links in emails or texts unless you are sure that they are coming from legitimate sources. Some suspicious emails and text messages may contain attachments and links to websites that try to install malicious software on your device.
Keep Your Keys Safe

Never share your usernames, passwords, or PINs on websites or applications that you are not sure about. Legitimate businesses do not ask you to disclose these or your payment information. If in doubt, stop and contact the business directly to verify the authenticity of the contact.
The Spam Folder is Your Friend

Don't reply to unsolicited messages. Replying to phishing and spam messages verifies the validity of your account, which will prompt more spam and attacks. Mark them as spam to avoid receiving more contacts from the suspicious source.
Surround Your Devices with a Digital Moat

Install an antivirus or anti-malware software and apply updates when available. Securing your system even by a little is better than not securing it at all. Fraudsters are after easy targets. Don't make their job easier.
How can I keep my SSN protected or report that it’s been compromised?

Please keep in mind that you should never share your Social Security Number/Social Insurance Number with anyone over the phone or through email. A Sezzle Shopper Support agent will never ask for it, either. For Sezzle’s verification purposes, you only need to enter it in the secure verification tool when prompted by Sezzle.

articles.title: How does Sezzle protect my account?

content.text: We understand the importance of keeping your Sezzle account safe and secure, and we've implemented several measures to ensure your account is always protected.
What measures does Sezzle take to protect my account?

We use real-time fraud monitoring and alerting to detect and prevent unauthorized activity on your account. Our system continuously monitors your account for suspicious transactions, including unrecognized activity and unusual spending patterns, and takes action where needed.
What happens if you detect suspicious activity on my account?

If we detect any suspicious activity on your account, we'll freeze your account and decline future transactions. If you don't recognize the transaction, we'll take the necessary steps to secure your account, including disabling your account temporarily and investigating the transaction.
Reference the resources below for extra measures you can take:
I don't recognize an order on my account.
I want to lock my virtual card and report fraudulent activity.
How do you determine what activity is suspicious?

Our system uses advanced algorithms to analyze your account activity and identify behavior patterns indicative of fraud. This includes things like sudden increases in spending, transactions made from unusual locations, and transactions made during abnormal hours.
Can I opt out of fraud monitoring and alerting?
Fraud monitoring and alerting are critical to our security measures and cannot be disabled. This service is necessary to protect your account from unauthorized access and fraudulent activity.
What can I do to help protect my account?
To help protect your account, we recommend that you:
Keep your login credentials secure, including your username and password

Regularly review your account activity and report any suspicious transactions; you can do this by locking your virtual card in your customer dashboard or App, disputing transactions, and contacting customer support. Please contact us as soon as you identify unauthorized transactions.
Avoid sharing your account information with anyone, including family members and friends.
How can I keep my SSN protected or report that it’s been compromised?

Please keep in mind that you should never share your Social Security Number/Social Insurance Number with anyone over the phone or through email. A Sezzle Shopper Support agent will never ask for it, either. For Sezzle’s verification purposes, you only need to enter it in the secure verification tool when prompted by Sezzle.

What's in it for you?
The chance to help your friends build their credit.

How do I refer someone to Sezzle?

If the person you are referring to Sezzle already has a Sezzle account, then neither of you will be eligible to receive Sezzle Points for the referral.
What if I refer someone but do not receive my Sezzle Points?
If you referred someone to Sezzle but have not received your Sezzle Points yet, here are some troubleshooting steps you can take:
Verify that the person you referred is a brand-new Sezzle shopper. If they had a preexisting Sezzle account, the referral will not be accepted.
Confirm that the person you referred has used Sezzle to place an order of at least $100 within 90 days of signing up. If the order total is below $100, you will not receive Sezzle Points.
Note that the Sezzle Points reward may take up to 14 days to be processed and credited to your Sezzle account. Your Sezzle Points expire if you don’t earn new Points within 90 days.
Why can't I refer a friend?

articles.title: What are Sezzle Monthly Installment Plans and how do they work?

content.text: What are Sezzle Monthly Installments?

Sezzle will now offer monthly payment plans for Virtual Card and select direct integration merchants. Installment lengths will range from 3 - 36 months and may be subject to a finance charge in the form of interest. Available monthly installment plans will appear in the regular checkout and purchase request user experience. Monthly installment loans may require a down payment based on creditworthiness.
Who is eligible for Monthly Installment Plans?
Eligibility criteria may include:
Must have an active account and verified SSN with Sezzle.
Must demonstrate positive transaction history and on-time repayment behavior with Sezzle.
Must be 18 years of age.
Must be an individual account. No co-applicants, co-signers, or authorized users are allowed.
Must reside in the United States
What are the fees & costs?

A finance charge will be applied to monthly installment plans based on an APR. APRs range from 0% - 35.99% and will vary depending on creditworthiness and term length. Interest will be calculated daily.

A Late Payment Fee of up to $16.95 may be applied if a user fails to make a payment by the scheduled due date. A Failed Payment Fee of up to $6.95 may be applied if Sezzle attempts to process a payment and it fails. Fees may vary by state. To learn more about fees, visit https://shopper-help.sezzle.com/hc/en-us/sections/19732704843668-Order-Payments-Fees
What happens if I miss a payment?

If we’re unable to process your payment on the due date, it will be marked as failed. You may be charged a Failed Payment Fee if your payment method is declined, and a Late Payment Fee if the payment is not received by the due date. Fee amounts may vary by state. To view full details about fees, visit https://shopper-help.sezzle.com/hc/en-us/sections/19732704843668-Order-Payments-Fees
If a payment remains unpaid, your loan may become past due, and your account may be restricted until the balance is brought current.
How do I pay off the loan?
The first payment will be due one month after the purchase and will occur on the same day of each subsequent month.

A scheduled payment method can be set up using a bank account or debit card, and users can opt into autopay. Autopay is not automatically applied and can be set up when completing an order or after an order is created from your order details page in the Sezzle customer dashboard.
Loans can be paid off by accessing the Orders tab in the app or in the customer dashboard. There are no fees for paying off the loan early.
Can I pay off my balance early?

Yes! Users can pay off their next payment or the entirety of their loan at any time. If users pay off the loan in full, they will not be charged unearned interest, which will lower the total cost of credit. If individual payments are paid off early, the re-amortization of the loan will affect the final payment.
Can I spend more with Monthly Installment Plans?

Monthly plans are offered for order amounts between $400 - $8,000. Original bi-weekly loans have a maximum order amount of $2,500. Spending power is not guaranteed; each loan application is subject to approval. You can view your current estimated spending power in the app or the Sezzle customer dashboard.
Why do I see 2 different spending powers?

The main amount displayed is the higher of your available biweekly or monthly payment spending power. Spending Power is an estimate and is not guaranteed and may change depending on a number of factors, including the merchant where you are shopping. Each order is evaluated at checkout.
Your biweekly spending power is the estimated amount you can spend on Pay Later loans.
Your monthly payment spending power is the estimated amount you can spend on monthly installment loans; interest may apply.
Does applying for a Monthly Installment Loan affect my credit score?
No, only a soft credit pull will be done to verify eligibility and determine the APR, which has no impact on your credit score.
Can I reschedule my payments?
No, monthly plans can not be rescheduled.
Will this loan be reported to credit bureaus?
We may report information about your account to credit bureaus. Late payments, missed payments, or other defaults on your account may be reflected in your credit report.
If you are enrolled in Sezzle Up, certain eligible bi-weekly loans may be reported to credit bureaus and may help build credit with on-time payments.

articles.title: How does Sezzle Up impact my credit?

content.text: If you decide to enroll in Sezzle Up and/or place a long-term financing order, you are opting to report your payment history to the credit bureaus.

We may report information about your account to credit bureaus. Late payments, missed payments, or other defaults on your account may be reflected in your credit report. If you are enrolled in Sezzle Up, certain eligible bi-weekly loans may be reported to credit bureaus and may help build credit with on-time payments.
What is reported to the credit bureaus?
At the end of each month, we review the overall standing of your account, including your outstanding balance and payment status to the following bureaus:
US: Equifax , Tran sunion , Experian , Innovis
Canada: Equifax
Payment statuses:
On-time payments - Payments not outstanding beyond 30 days will be reported as on time.

Failed or late payments - Payments overdue by 30 days or more will be reported on the monthly report beginning in the first month that it's 30 days overdue. For example, if you have a failed payment on January 10th, it will not be reported in January. However, if it's still unresolved by the end of February, it would be reported in February and every additional month that it isn't resolved. The longer a payment is failed on your account, the worse the impact will be on your credit score.

You can view how each month has been reported to the bureaus in the Sezzle app by selecting "Account" and then "Sezzle Up" under the Benefits section. This page will display if a particular month has been reported to the credit bureaus and if it was reported with on-time payments ("Current") or with any delinquencies ("Not Current"). If there is nothing filled in for the month, then that means we haven’t reported anything for that month yet.

Canada: Sign up for Borrowell

articles.title: How do I dispute information on my credit report?

content.text: At Sezzle, we strive to help you pay responsibly. We are committed to providing accurate information about your account and payment history. If you see something you don’t recognize or what you believe may be a potential error on your credit report, your first step should be to contact Sezzle through our Support team to have it investigated and addressed.

Select the following Category:

From there, we will investigate and notify you of the results. If we discover that an error occurred, we will ensure it is corrected with the credit bureaus in a timely manner. At your request, we can also furnish a clarification letter to any prospective creditors who may need to know that we corrected an error in your record.

Please remember that there may be a lag between what you see in your Sezzle dashboard and what shows up on your credit report. Sezzle reports credit activity once a month after the reporting month is over. We do not report credit information daily or in real time. This means it is very common to see differences on your credit report compared to the details you see when you log in to your account. The credit report information furnishing happens at a “point in time,” whereas your balances and spending limits shown in your Sezzle dashboard are always changing. Balances and purchases made after the month's end snapshot of your information to the credit bureaus will not reflect on your credit report until the following reporting period.

articles.title: What are Payment Streaks (Loyalty Tiers)?

content.text: Payment Streaks are part of Sezzle’s free Loyalty Tiers program, where you can move up the loyalty tiers by consistently and successfully making your Sezzle payments on time. See loyalty tier benefits below.
Unless subject to ineligibility , you agree to be automatically enrolled, at no cost, in Sezzle’s Loyalty Terms program by opening a Sezzle Account or using Sezzle Services.
How it Works

Each eligible payment (including down payment or installment) that is successfully paid on or before its originally scheduled due date will count as one (1) “streak.” You can upgrade to the next tier after reaching the required streak count of successful payments within a rolling 90-day window* without missed or failed payment history, except for Resolved Payments.
Once an eligible payment is done “processing” and marked as “paid” in our system, the streak will be issued.
Resolved Payments are payments that fail (on or before the due date) and are successfully paid by the original due date (11:59 pm UTC).

*The rolling 90-day window starts on the launch date of the loyalty tiers program or on the day you open your Sezzle Account, if after the program’s launch. The 90-day window resets upon a tier upgrade, downgrade, or when the 90 days have passed. For the Platinum, Diamond, and Onyx tiers, you need to earn the minimum required streak count of successful payments within that 90-day window in order to maintain your tier. If you fail to do so, you will be downgraded a tier. The lowest you can get downgraded for inactivity is the Gold tier.

Missed payments and payments that fail and are not successfully paid on the same day (before 11:59 pm UTC) will result in a tier downgrade and reset your streak count to zero. Resolved Payments will not result in a tier downgrade or reset your streak count.
Payments Ineligible for Streaks
Payments ineligible for streaks:
Payments below $15 (including bundled payments* and Sezzle subscription payments under $15)
Payments that failed , even when attempting to pay early
Any “resolved payments” (Payments that failed at any time and were corrected)
Payments rescheduled later than the original payment due date
Payments on refunded or canceled orders (if streaks were applied, they will be deducted)
Payments charged back by your bank (if streaks were applied, they will be deducted)
Long-term financing payments
*Bundled payments are not counted as a sum of their bundled total but on an individual basis.
Loyalty Tier Benefits
The benefits of loyalty tiers can include the following:
Bonuses when you refer friends to Sezzle.

Platinum, Diamond, or Onyx tiers: (US only) Failed Payment Fee Forgiveness—If your payment fails on the due date and you incur a Failed Payment Fee, we'll waive the fee once every calendar month. You must be in the tier at the time of the failed payment.
Platinum, Diamond, or Onyx tiers: Subscription eligibility for Sezzle Premium (Restrictions apply).
To see the specific benefits for each loyalty tier from the Sezzle app, go to the Payment Streaks page within the Shop tab and click “Compare Benefits.”

articles.title: Trouble Using a Single-Use Card with Expedia or Travel Sites
breadcrumbs: Using Virtual Cards in the U.S.

content.text: When booking travel through third-party sites like Expedia, you may run into issues using your Sezzle Single-Use Virtual Card. This is due to how those sites process payments.
Why did the Single-Use Card get declined on Expedia?

Expedia and similar travel sites often process your order through multiple merchants (e.g., different airlines or service providers). Since Sezzle’s Single-Use Virtual Card can only be used with one merchant, any additional charges from a second merchant will cause the card to decline or result in multiple pending transactions.
Why do I see multiple pending authorizations on my account?
If Expedia split your booking between two airlines, each airline may attempt to charge your Sezzle card separately. This can cause:
One charge to go through,
One charge to decline,
Or both to show as pending if the merchant hasn’t fully processed the order yet.
Pending charges will typically clear in 7 business days if the order is not captured by the merchant.
What should I do to successfully book travel?
To avoid these issues:
Create a separate Sezzle Single-Use Card for each airline or merchant and a separate order for each through Expedia , or
Book directly with the airline , which helps ensure a single merchant is used for the transaction.
Can Sezzle cancel or release the pending transaction?
Unfortunately, Sezzle cannot cancel or expedite the release of pending authorizations. These are temporary holds placed by the merchant, and they must expire or be canceled on their end.
Once the hold expires or the merchant confirms they will not process the charge, the funds will be released automatically.
What happens if my flight wasn’t booked, but I have a charge?
If the order was not successfully processed by the merchant, the charge will typically remain pending for up to 7 business days. If it’s not captured, it will be automatically canceled.
If you are unsure about the status of your booking, we recommend contacting the airline or Expedia directly for more information.

content.text: Sezzle Anywhere and the Virtual Card are only available for shoppers in the U.S. at this time. No international purchases will be accepted. Availability and pricing plans for Sezzle Anywhere may vary by individual. There is no physical card for Sezzle at this time.

How do I sign up?
If you’re new to Sezzle, you must first download the Sezzle app and set up a Sezzle account. Please have your mobile phone and a payment method (credit/debit card or bank account information) handy.

Once you are logged in to your account through the Sezzle app, select the “Virtual Card” tab, or if you’re on a mobile device, click here . We’ll then take you step-by-step through getting a multi-use virtual card.
Create a Purchase Request
Purchase requests are required for each multi-use virtual card purchase. Follow the steps below to create and approve a purchase request.

(For general virtual card use or when shopping with Sezzle Anywhere .)

Your transaction will be declined if you attempt to use the Sezzle Virtual Card without an active purchase request that covers the entire amount of the order. To access the card number, expiration date, and security code, you can either log into the Sezzle app and select the "Virtual Card" tab or log into your Sezzle dashboard through a web browser and select “Virtual Card.” We recommend using the copy function and pasting the information into the merchant’s checkout page to avoid errors when entering the card information.
Once your order is placed, you will receive a confirmation email from Sezzle. You can then log into your account to view your payment dates and amounts.
How to Add to Your Mobile Wallet & Pay In-Store

After creating a purchase request, the “Add to Wallet” option will become available so you can add the virtual card to your digital wallet (Google Pay or Apple Pay only). To add the virtual card to Apple Pay or Google Pay, log in to the Sezzle app, select the “Virtual Card” tab, and then the "Add to Wallet" button below the card image. You’ll then be walked through the steps to configure the card to the correct wallet.
If you’ve already added the multi-use virtual card to your wallet, you do not need to re-add it as the card details do not change. Creating the purchase request activates the same card for use.

Once the card has been added, you can use it at checkout just like any other virtual card – by unlocking and tapping your phone at the payment terminal. For more information on how to set up and use Apple Pay, click here . For more information on how to set up and use Google Pay, click here .
Common Questions
What happens if I attempt to use the virtual card without having an active purchase request?

Can I cancel a purchase request after agreeing to loan terms?
Yes, if you decide not to proceed with the purchase or change your mind, simply navigate to the Virtual Card tab, identify your purchase request, and select “Cancel.”
Why did my purchase request expire?
Either you did not make a purchase within the 72-hour period, or the merchant did not confirm your order. When the purchase request expires, you may request another and attempt the purchase again.
What if I don’t use the entire purchase request?

Since you are not charged until you make the purchase, your payment plan will be updated to reflect the new order total divided into four payments and new payment due dates, and your estimated spending power will be adjusted to reflect the new purchase.
What if my purchase ends up being more than the purchase amount?

You must request a new one for the higher amount. Ensure it is within your estimated spending power. You can cancel the current purchase to free up your estimated spending power if needed. Please note that purchase requests cannot be combined to complete an order with a higher transaction total. For example, two approved purchase requests of $25 cannot be used to complete an order for $50.

After that, any new in-store single-use cards will be added automatically, making tap-to-pay purchases faster and easier! You won’t be charged until you make a purchase using the single-use card. At the time of purchase, you'll be charged for the amount requested on the card, starting with the down payment plus any applicable service fees, followed by installments every two weeks until the order is paid off. If you don't use the full amount on the single-use card, the difference will be returned to you in the form of an order reconciliation after the order has been fully processed by the merchant, which should be within 7 days.
Remember, each single-use card can only be used once, so you'll need a new one for each purchase.

You will be able to reference which virtual card merchants incur a fee in the Sezzle app under the following filters: “Anywhere,” “Premium,” and “Sezzle Partner.” Learn more about the service fee here .
What payment method is the single-use card connected to?
Your default payment methods for Down Payments and Scheduled Payments will be used when you make a purchase with a single-use virtual card.

The card required for the Down Payment will be charged 20% or 25% of the total amount, depending on your payment plan, including any service fee, requested on the single-use card. The remaining payments will be charged to your default payment method for Scheduled Payments. Reference: How do I set a payment method as the default?

articles.title: What is Sezzle Mobile?

content.text: What is Sezzle Mobile?

Sezzle Mobile is a wireless phone plan operating on AT&T’s nationwide network, available directly through the Sezzle app. It’s designed to be simple, flexible, and designed to offer flexible pricing for Sezzle members.
No long-term commitments. Just phone service.
Who can sign up for Sezzle Mobile?
Sezzle Mobile is available to eligible Sezzle users in the United States. To sign up, you must have a Sezzle account, which requires you to be at least 18 years old.
There is no credit check and no minimum Sezzle account history required, so even newly created accounts may be eligible.
Primary account holders can add additional lines to their plan, including for minors, but the plan must be opened by an eligible adult.
How much does Sezzle Mobile cost?
Base monthly pricing depends on your Sezzle membership status::
• $29.99/month for Anywhere members
• $39.99/month for Sezzle Premium members
• $49.99/month for all other users
Applicable taxes, fees, surcharges are not included and will be added to your monthly charge.
What happens if my Sezzle membership changes?

If you upgrade or downgrade your account, you’ll automatically become eligible for the corresponding Sezzle Mobile price based on your current membership status. Changes will take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
Are there contracts or cancellation fees?
There are no long-term contracts or cancellation fees.

You can cancel your Sezzle Mobile plan at any time through the Sezzle app. Your service will remain active through the end of your current billing period. You will not be billed for future service after your current billing period ends.
What network does Sezzle Mobile use?
Sezzle Mobile operates on AT&T’s nationwide network infrastructure, providing coverage across the United States.
Coverage and service quality depend on your location, device compatibility, and network availability.
What’s included in the Sezzle Mobile plan?
All Sezzle Mobile plans include:
Unlimited nationwide domestic talk and text
Unlimited data*
Mobile hotspot included
International Roaming in Canada and Mexico. International roaming availability and speeds may vary.
eSIM activation for compatible devices
*Network management practices may apply during periods of congestion.
What is an eSIM?
An eSIM is a digital SIM that lets you activate a cellular plan without using a physical SIM card.
Sezzle Mobile currently supports eSIM only. Physical SIM cards are not currently offered.
You can learn more about eSIMs and supported devices here: https://support.apple.com/en-us/118669.
Do I need a new phone to use Sezzle Mobile?
Not necessarily.
Your phone must:
• Be unlocked
• Support eSIM
• Be compatible with AT&T’s network
Device compatibility will be determined during sign-up in the Sezzle app.
Can I keep my current phone number?
In most cases you can transfer (port) your existing phone number when you activate Sezzle Mobile.
Eligibility and timing for number transfers will be confirmed during activation.
When will Sezzle Mobile be available?
Sezzle Mobile is expected to roll out in phases, starting with a waitlist. Availability may vary based on eligibility, device compatibility, and network requirements.
How do I sign up?
Sezzle Mobile has its own section in the Sezzle app called Sezzle Mobile.
Here’s how it works:
1. Join the waitlist in the Sezzle app
2. Get notified if you become eligible
3. Choose your plan and activate your service directly in-app
How will I be billed?

Your Sezzle Mobile plan will be billed monthly to your selected payment method and will automatically renew each month until canceled. You authorize recurring monthly billing to your selected payment method.
Billing details, renewal dates, taxes, and fees will be visible in the Sezzle app.
Where can I get help?
Support for Sezzle Mobile will be available directly through the Sezzle app. You’ll be able to manage your plan, find help articles, and contact support all in one place.

articles.title: Using the Sezzle Browser Extension (iOS Only)

content.text: What is Sezzle’s Browser Extension?
Sezzle’s Browser Extension is a free Safari extension for iOS devices that helps find coupon codes and Sezzle Spend-back offers from select retail partners.
Currently, it is only available to users who have the Sezzle app installed and updated to the latest version on their iOS device.
Do I need to download another app to use the Sezzle Browser Extension?

Nope ! All Sezzle Browser Extension features are integrated within the Sezzle app. Please make sure you have the latest version of the Sezzle app and the browser extension installed to access all available offers.

Note: The Sezzle Browser Extension is only available on iOS. All extension features are integrated within the Sezzle app, so make sure you have the latest version of the Sezzle app and browser extension installed to access all available offers.
How do I install and use the Sezzle Browser Extension?
To install:
Confirm your device is updated to the latest iOS version.
Download or update the Sezzle app to the newest version.
Open Safari, tap the “aA” icon in the address bar, select “Manage Extensions,” and enable “Sezzle.”
Follow any prompts to allow permissions, and be sure to select “Allow on Every Website” for tracking permissions to ensure full extension functionality.
Once enabled, the extension will display applicable Sezzle Spend offers while browsing participating retailers. You can click “Activate” on eligible offers to begin earning rewards.
If you are having trouble installing the extension, visit https://sezzle.com/install-extension on your iOS device for step-by-step instructions!
Where can I find the browser extension Sezzle Spend offers?
To view available offers:
Ensure the extension is installed and enabled in Safari.
Open Safari, tap the “aA” icon, and select “Sezzle.”
After clicking "Sezzle," a list of spend-back offers will appear. You can use the search bar to discover more stores offering spend-back offers.

The extension will also automatically display offer notifications when you visit a participating store’s website. Just shop on Safari like you normally would, and look for the purple Sezzle banner in your search results to discover stores offering Sezzle Spend rewards.
How do I deactivate the Sezzle Browser Extension?
To deactivate the Sezzle Browser Extension:
Open your device Settings and navigate to Safari .
Tap “Extensions” and locate “Sezzle.”
Toggle off the switch to disable the extension.
You may re-enable it anytime by returning to the same settings and toggling the switch back on.

articles.title: Troubleshooting the Browser Extension

content.text: What if I encounter issues during installation or use?

If you encounter issues when installing or activating the extension, check your Safari settings to ensure the extension is enabled and that permissions are set correctly. Screenshots of these settings can help troubleshoot common problems. If you require assistance, please don't hesitate to reach out to support at Support@Sezzle.com .
Why did my purchase not qualify for Sezzle Spend when using the browser extension?
Some purchases may not qualify for Sezzle Spend even when using Sezzle’s browser extension. Please review all exclusions and policies in the extension before purchasing.
There are several reasons a reward may not be issued:
The purchase was made via an unsupported browser.
Privacy or ad-blocking tools interfered with tracking.
Did not properly activate the Spend Back offer, or didn’t place an order after activating the offer.
The purchase included excluded categories.
The purchase occurred outside the merchant’s approved referral window.
The merchant hasn’t reported the purchase to Sezzle’s partner network. Some merchants notify us within an hour, and occasionally, other merchants can take up to several days to notify us of a sale.

We recommend checking the extension’s offer terms before each purchase. If it’s been more than 3 days and nothing is showing, please reply with an itemized receipt as a valid proof of purchase, and our Support team can take a closer look. The receipt must clearly display:
Purchase date
Merchant name
Item(s) purchased
Total purchase amount
Accepted file formats: PNG, JPG, PDF.

articles.title: Tracking and Receiving Your Sezzle Spend Rewards

content.text: What does it mean if my Sezzle Spend is pending?

If your Sezzle Spend reward is marked as pending , it means the merchant has reported your purchase to Sezzle, but the reward hasn’t been confirmed or paid out yet. This pending period allows time for returns, cancellations, or other adjustments before the reward becomes available.
Pending rewards usually appear in your account within 3 days of completing a qualifying purchase after activating a browser extension offer.
Once visible, they typically take 60–120 days to move to your available balance, depending on the merchant’s confirmation timeline.
To view your pending rewards:
Open the Sezzle app
Go to the Account tab → Tap Sezzle Spend
Look under the Pending section, where you’ll also see any rewards that were later cancelled
How can I view the Sezzle Spend rewards earned on browser extension purchases?
To check your earned Sezzle Spend:
Open the Sezzle app.
Tap the “Account” tab and go to “Sezzle Spend.”
You'll see the Available and History tabs. If you have pending Sezzle Spend, a Pending section will also appear.

Note: It may take up to 3 days for a reward to appear as pending after a qualifying purchase. Some purchases may not qualify for Sezzle Spend. Be sure to review all exclusions and offer details in the browser extension before making a purchase.
When will I see the Sezzle Spend earned from a browser extension purchase in my account?

Eligible rewards are typically credited to your account within 60–120 days of purchase. Timelines may vary depending on the retailer’s reporting and approval process. Some merchants notify us within an hour, and occasionally, other merchants can take up to several days to notify us of a sale. Processing times can vary based on the retailer’s policies and the nature of the transaction. Once the reward is credited, you’ll receive a notification.
Enabling push notifications in the app is the best way to get notified when your Sezzle Spend is available for us. You can do that here !
Are there any limits to how much Sezzle Spend I can earn?

There is no set limit to the number of Sezzle Spend offers you can redeem with the Sezzle Browser Extension. However, individual retailers may have specific terms and conditions, such as minimum purchase amounts, specific qualifying items, or exclusions. Always review the offer details before making a purchase.

articles.title: Using Gas & Dining Offers

content.text: Why didn't I get a discount at the pump?

Sorry for any confusion with this! Gas & Dining offers are not a coupon or rewards card. Instead, after your eligible purchase has been completed and confirmed, you’ll earn Sezzle Points that can later be redeemed for rewards like Sezzle Spend or gift cards.
What if the sign price at the station is different from the price in the app?

The price displayed in the Sezzle app should match the price shown on the gas station’s sign; however, occasionally, Sezzle’s price may differ from the actual price on the station's sign. The good news is that we can see exactly when you bought gas, and we cross-reference each of your transactions with the gas stations' records. Your Sezzle Points will be calculated based on the number of gallons of gas you purchased at the price shown on your receipt or in the gas station’s transaction log. So even if the gas prices don't match, you'll still receive the ¢/gal reward in the form of Sezzle Points as noted.
After I’ve claimed my Gas & Dining offer, how much time do I have to make my purchase?
Time varies by the type of offer:

The Sezzle Virtual Card – You can access the Sezzle Virtual Card from the Virtual Card tab in the Sezzle App.
A physical debit or credit card that is linked to your Sezzle account as a payment method.

What is the receipt upload option for Gas & Dining offers?

After you claim an offer in the Earn tab, you’ll see the offer details, the amount of Sezzle Points you can earn, and a new option to “Upload a receipt.” Once you make your purchase at the offer location and have your receipt, you can either take a photo in the app or upload one from your phone’s gallery. Travel to the offer location and complete your purchase.
Open the Offer Details page in the Sezzle app.
Select “Upload a receipt.”
Allow the app to access your camera or photos.
Take a clear photo of your receipt or upload one from your device’s gallery.
Submit the image to finalize your claim.

Once uploaded, your receipt will be reviewed. On average, it takes 2 days for Sezzle Points to be credited to your account from the day you claim an offer; however, it may occasionally take up to 10 days.

content.text: Where are Gas & Dining offers available?

Gas & Dining offers are available at thousands of gas stations, restaurants, convenience stores, and grocery stores across the U.S. You can see locations near you by downloading the Sezzle app and checking out your Earn tab to see your local options, or by searching a city or town you'll be traveling to!
We're working every day to add more locations, so keep an eye out for new locations in the Sezzle app!
Gas & Dining offers are not yet available in Canada.
Why are gas offers lower than usual right now?

Gas stations set the price you pay based on the wholesale price they paid per gallon + a markup, so they can earn a small profit. The wholesale price that stations pay per gallon changes daily, which means your discounts change daily, too!
Why do offers vary at my favorite business(es)?

All Gas & Dining offers are personalized, so the offers you see are customized just for you! The offer you receive can be influenced by the current business needs of the location, the time of day, the date, and more. Offers also depend on how much business they have and whether they are seeking more business, among other factors. Offers can vary, even between you and your best friend, depending on when, where, and how they are receiving their offers.
That being said, you might sometimes see differences in offers from this scenario.

Click here for Gas & Dining Terms and Conditions.

50 gal max per gas transaction (swipe of card)

articles.title: Earnings & Sezzle Points

content.text: I claimed an offer, but didn’t earn anything. What happened?
To earn Sezzle Points with Gas & Dining offers, ensure you use the Sezzle app correctly. Here are some reminders:
